A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card with the corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-D-advosze-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Advosze (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 30 November 2016): Same game text. A slip again: the lower part of the card with a white italic “E” in the black lower border and no title.

The same area of the 2016 disc card image (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip; nothing else is edited.
